page.overview:
Who is Chialingosaurus?

(meaning "Chialing lizard") is an extinct genus of herbivorous stegosaur dinosaur from China.

Chialingosaurus is illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the Dinopedia of the Jurassic Park Institute, but hasn't received a dino card before its closure in 2006. However, it would receive a profile on the website Dinosaur Earth on Dinopedia.

Chialingosaurus is among the dinosaurs that appear in the Jurassic World: Dino Escape section.
